title: Low Fire
description: Low fire in First-Person view to enhance screen visibility
body:
Tired of being blinded every time you take a dip in lava? This Minecraft Java resource pack dramatically lowers the intrusive first-person fire animation, shrinking the flames to the bottom of your screen.

Now, instead of a wall of orange blocking your sight, you get a clean, unobstructed view. It's a must-have for PvP, Nether exploration, and general survival—allowing you to actually see your enemies, navigate hazards, and find water before it's too late.

Key Features
Enhanced Visibility: Redesigned first-person overlay clears up to 70% of the screen.

Survival & PvP Friendly: Never lose track of your target or surroundings while burning.

Vanilla Friendly: Keeps the classic look of Minecraft fire, just perfectly resized.
